style: Purely instrumental orchestral pop, adventurous fantasy ensemble soundtrack, 112 BPM. Violins carry the main melody throughout, with French horns, piano arpeggios, woodwinds, cellos, bass and steady pop drums. Hopeful, expansive and full of wonder. Instrumental introduction, soaring orchestral theme, reflective piano interlude, full ensemble reprise. End with a resolved orchestral chord and a natural instrumental reverb tail. Every lead phrase and the entire outro are played by musical instruments. No human voice at any point: no singing, humming, chanting, choir, scat, speech or vocal samples.
